g.text: SELECT A LABEL FROM THE WORD BANK • PLACE IT NEAR THE CORRECT PART
Select any label tile from the word bank below.
Place it near the matching part of the flower.
The dashed slots show where answers belong.
• Style — tube connecting stigma to ovary
Use the buttons below for hints, answers, or reset.
Each popup closes with its X button.
EDUCATIONAL TOOL · FLOWER ANATOMY · NO JAVASCRIPT REQUIRED
Click labels to highlight corresponding flower parts
The petal protects the inner reproductive parts.
The stamen includes both anther and filament.
The pistil connects through the style to the stigma.
Select any word bank tile to see its definition.
The dashed slots indicate where answers belong.
Click the close button to return to the diagram.
ALL LABELS ARE INTERACTIVE — CLICK ANY WORD BANK ITEM
Review your selections against the correct positions
SEPAL → Green protective leaf at base
ANTHER → Tip of stamen producing pollen
STYLE → Tube connecting stigma and ovary
STIGMA → Sticky pollen receptor at top
RECEPTACLE → Base holding all flower parts
When all labels match their slots, your answer is complete.
Compare your placements with the arrow guides on the diagram.
Clear all selections and return to start
Are you sure you want to reset?
This will clear all placed labels and hide popups.
RETURN TO MAIN DIAGRAM WITH ALL LABELS CLEARED
